# M. Ali Petek — malipetek.dev

> Full-stack developer. Builds Shopify apps, small games, and the tools he wishes
> existed. This site also publishes a public knowledgebase of agentic coding
> sessions and exposes it over MCP.

## Endpoints

- Knowledgebase (HTML): https://malipetek.dev/kb
- Knowledgebase (JSON list): https://malipetek.dev/kb/entries
- Knowledgebase (JSON entry): https://malipetek.dev/kb/<slug>.json
- Knowledgebase REST API: https://malipetek-intercom.malipetek.workers.dev/kb/entries
- Search: https://malipetek.dev/kb?q=<terms>
- MCP (streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-06-18): https://malipetek.dev/mcp
- MCP discovery manifest: https://malipetek.dev/.well-known/mcp-server.json
- Agent setup guide: https://malipetek.dev/agents
- WebMCP: pages register in-page tools via document.modelContext when the
  browser implements it (search_knowledge, open_knowledge_entry, open_intercom)
- Client portal: https://malipetek.dev/portal
- Writing: https://malipetek.dev/blog
- Work history: https://malipetek.dev/experience
- DeepSeek Harness plugins (HTML): https://malipetek.dev/plugins
- DeepSeek Harness plugins (JSON list): https://malipetek.dev/plugins.json
- DeepSeek Harness plugin (JSON): https://malipetek.dev/plugins/<slug>.json

## MCP tools

Public (no auth):

- search_knowledge(query, status?, tag?, language?, limit?) — full-text search
- get_knowledge(id_or_slug) — one entry, full markdown
- list_knowledge(limit?) — newest entries, no bodies

Author (Authorization: Bearer ack_… , issued by the site owner only):

- create_knowledge(title, problem, solution, status, language?, framework?, tags?, author_agent)
- update_knowledge(id, …) — only for entries that key authored

Client (agent key cat_…, minted in the portal, or OAuth):

- portal_projects, portal_requests, portal_request, portal_file_request,
  portal_reply, portal_set_budget, portal_withdraw — file and follow requests;
  each still waits for Ali.
- Doing the work yourself (the agent the client already pays for):
  project_context, workspace_files, workspace_read, submit_change,
  preview_build — read the site’s source, send a change on the request’s
  branch, build it to the preview. Costs the client $0 in AI on our bill.
- Site: site_status, site_deploys, site_publish, site_rollback — previews and
  publish on malipetek.online, behind the clientPublish setting.

## Knowledgebase notes

- Public read, owner-only write. There is no self-serve API key route.
- Entries are problem/solution pairs from real sessions. Status is one of
  `solved`, `workaround`, `unsolvable` (a dead end documented with evidence).
- Fields: id, slug, title, problem_md, solution_md, status, language, framework,
  tags[], author_agent, created_at, updated_at.
- Search uses SQLite FTS5 with quoted prefix tokens. Raw FTS syntax in a query
  is sanitised, never passed through.

## DeepSeek Harness plugins

- Plugins for DeepSeek Harness (Cordis packages), published to npm under the
  `@malipetek` scope. Source lives in `packages/` of the site repository.
- Install inside the harness: `dsh plugin add @malipetek/dsh-<name>`, or use
  "Add plugin" in the plugin manager.
- Installed plugins do not update automatically: upgrading means removing the
  old version and adding the new one.
- Each plugin may ship a Host half (`index.js`) and a browser half
  (`./client`), declared through the `dsh.client` field of its package.json.
- The page reports live npm state. A package with no registry entry yet is
  shown as `unpublished`; that is not an error.
